meta_description: GuineaGood helps you choose suitable foods for guinea pigs with clear and helpful information.
title: GuineaGood
lead: Discover safe, useful foods for guinea pigs through a simple and educational experience.
about_text: GuineaGood helps users discover foods suitable for guinea pigs, their categories, benefits and recommended uses. An application designed to inform and guide responsible owners. Give them foods that are recommended for them, and avoid those that are harmful to them. Our little friends are fragile.
feature_1_text: Browse a catalog of guinea-pig-safe foods with clear information about their role and use.
feature_2_text: Find a food item in seconds thanks to an intuitive multilingual search.
feature_3_text: Understand the benefits, categories and key indications to make better choices for your pet.
feature_4_text: The privacy policy is easy to access and personal data is handled in a clear, responsible way.
download_text: GuineaGood is available on the Google Play Store. Use the link below to open the app listing.
